params.1273: Search the cellar to locate the dragon's food bowl and put the drugged meat in it.
params.1292: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.
params.1274: Explore the cellar until you find the food bowl.
params.1275: Use the food on the bowl to aid Sir Vant with his plan (make sure to right-click and select 'Use').
